openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Tuesday’s gate is fog lifting, camps opening, and a Bears win already in the books — not the admin stack. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. Own the threshold from the first breath.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds clears the static. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then the rest of the board.

mindset.body: Dom does not wait for a perfect inbox to start. Fierce calm is Tuesday composure after Vegas and before the Wed check: charge first, body second, journal third, two must-dos only, quiet admin after the morning has already won. One breath, one move, one clear next step. Competitors may still be refreshing MNF recaps or agent-pause filings; he arrives prepared for the day’s real work. When pressure rises, he slows the breath, names the next action, and outlasts the noise. Today is about banking calm so the week’s real moves have a settled operator behind them. Fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Tuesday: run this after Morning Charge — box breathing first, then the body. Fog clearing outside; tempo inside before camps and the two must-dos. Then news and the day.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom’s RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time. Optional: Front Clips / Back Clips if you want a second RipStick move.
